releases.body:
- `integrations/openclaw/opencode-dispatch`: an OpenClaw skill with a small wrapper around `opencode run`. A new task always gets `--archived` and the inbox prefix, and a task without `--title` is refused, so an agent cannot forget either. Follow-ups with `-s <id>` pass through unchanged. See *Using it with OpenClaw* in the README.
- The menubar menu ends with a "N more" row when there are more tasks than `max` (a native menu cannot scroll); the in-window list still shows them all.
- README screenshots now ship to npm.

First public release.

- A quiet badge at the top right of the session header, with a fixed-height, scrolling task list
- A macOS menubar item; click a task and OpenCode comes forward on that session
- Tasks you take over from the desktop composer are unarchived into regular sessions
- Read tasks stay for 24 hours by default; running, unread and failed tasks stay until you have seen them
- English by default; set `locale` to `zh` for Chinese or `auto` to follow OpenCode

Install: `opencode plugin add opencode-openclaw-inbox`
